Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 955/2019

Dear Ms. Rathore,

Thank you for meeting us on 21/12/2019 about your dispute with Abhishek Swamy. As we understand it, the complaint alleges negligence during treatment. The matter is listed before the Vadodara Sessions Court.

Our advice is to rely on the expert committee opinion that there was no gross negligence. Please collect the treatment records and the expert committee opinion and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
